title: ZeroTurn normalized event
description: What an adapter sends to zeroturn event --harness normalized on standard input. One event per invocation. Anything not listed here is refused, which keeps private content out of ZeroTurn.

contract.description: The contract this event follows. A different value is refused.

harness.description: Short name of the coding harness, for example claude.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the session the harness reports.

cwd.description: Working directory of the session, used to find the repository and its configuration.

model.description: Model label as the harness shows it.

fiveHourResetsAt.description: When the five hour window resets, as seconds since the epoch. Send it whenever the harness reports one: with it ZeroTurn can tell a window filling faster than the clock from one that will reset in time, and without it only the level is known.

sevenDayResetsAt.description: When the seven day window resets, as seconds since the epoch.

agentId.description: Identifier of the subagent, on subagent.start and subagent.stop.

backgroundTasks.description: How many background tasks are running. The count only, never their descriptions.

filePath.description: On file.read, the file a read tool is about to open.

command.description: On command.ran, the command that ran and succeeded. It is compared with the validation steps the repository configures and is not stored: what reaches a record is the name of the step it matched, or nothing.
